questions.stem: A company is performing a risk assessment on new software the company plans to use. Which of the following should the company assess during this process?
questions.explanation: Kerentanan software menunjukkan bagaimana kelemahan produk dapat berdampak pada aset dan proses bisnis.

questions.stem: A malicious actor is trying to access sensitive financial information from a company's database by intercepting and reusing log-in credentials. Which of the following attacks is the malicious actor attempting?
questions.explanation: Serangan on-path melibatkan pihak yang berada di jalur komunikasi dan dapat mengamati atau mengubah pertukaran data.

questions.stem: A new employee accessed an unauthorized website. An investigation found that the employee violated the company’s rules. Which of the following did the employee violate?
questions.explanation: Acceptable use policy menetapkan cara pengguna boleh memakai sistem dan akses internet perusahaan.

questions.stem: A systems administrator is reviewing the VPN logs and notices that during non-working hours a user is accessing the company file server and information is being transferred to a suspicious IP address. Which of the following threats is most likely occurring?
questions.explanation: Transfer file yang mencurigakan ke tujuan eksternal adalah indikator eksfiltrasi. Verifikasi volume, tujuan, dan otorisasi transfer.

questions.stem: A company discovers suspicious transactions that were entered into the company's database and attached to a user account that was created as a trap for malicious activity. Which of the following is the user account an example of?
questions.explanation: Honeytoken merupakan umpan seperti akun atau kredensial palsu yang dapat memicu alert ketika digunakan.

questions.stem: A network engineer is increasing the overall security of network devices and needs to harden the devices. Which of the following will best accomplish this task?
questions.explanation: SSH mengenkripsi sesi administrasi. Telnet mengirim data sesi dalam bentuk yang dapat dibaca di jaringan.

questions.stem: A company's accounting department receives an urgent payment message from the company's bank domain with instructions to wire transfer funds. The sender requests that the transfer be completed as soon as possible. Which of the following attacks is described?
questions.explanation: Permintaan transfer mendesak yang menyalahgunakan komunikasi bisnis merupakan pola business email compromise.

questions.stem: A company filed a complaint with its IT service provider after the company discovered the service provider's external audit team had access to some of the company's confidential information. Which of the following is the most likely reason the company filed the complaint?
options: The MOU had basic clauses from a template.
A SOW had not been agreed to by the client.
A WO had not been mutually approved.
A required NDA had not been signed.
questions.explanation: NDA menetapkan kewajiban menjaga kerahasiaan informasi yang diterima selama pekerjaan.

questions.stem: Which of the following aspects of the data management life cycle is most directly impacted by local and international regulations?
questions.explanation: Regulasi dapat menetapkan durasi penyimpanan, kewajiban penghapusan, dan pengecualian seperti legal hold.

questions.stem: An analyst is reviewing job postings to ensure sensitive company information is not being shared with the general public. Which of the following is the analyst most likely looking for?
questions.explanation: Versi software dapat mengungkap teknologi dan paparan terhadap kerentanan yang telah diketahui.

questions.stem: An engineer has ensured that the switches are using the latest OS, the servers have the latest patches, and the endpoints’ definitions are up to date. Which of the following will these actions most effectively prevent?
questions.explanation: Patch dan definisi terbaru mengurangi paparan terhadap teknik serta kerentanan yang sudah diketahui.

questions.stem: A company is reviewing the supply-chain risk of low-cost IoT devices for its infrastructure. Which factor should it assess?
questions.explanation: Asal dan rantai pasok perangkat penting untuk menilai integritas perangkat dan dukungan dari pemasok.

questions.stem: A company captures log-in details and reviews them each week to identify conditions such as excessive log-in attempts and frequent lockouts. Which of the following should a security analyst recommend to improve security compliance monitoring?
options: Including the date and person who reviewed the information in a report
Adding automated alerting when anomalies occur
Requiring a statement each week that no exceptions were noted
Masking the username in a report to protect privacy
questions.explanation: Alert otomatis mengangkat anomali saat terjadi sehingga pemeriksaan dapat dimulai sebelum jadwal review mingguan.

questions.stem: A security team is in the process of hardening the network against externally crafted malicious packets. Which of the following is the most secure method to protect the internal network?
questions.explanation: IPS yang dipasang inline dapat memeriksa paket dan memblokir pola berbahaya sesuai kebijakan.

questions.stem: An unauthorized laptop connects to an employee’s phone network port. Which control best limits the laptop's ability to reach the database network from that segment?
questions.explanation: Segmentasi membatasi keterjangkauan jaringan database dari segmen port telepon. Autentikasi port dapat melengkapi kontrol ini.

questions.stem: Which of the following should a systems administrator use to decrease the company's hardware attack surface?
questions.explanation: Virtualisasi dapat mengonsolidasikan workload sehingga jumlah perangkat fisik yang perlu dikelola berkurang.

questions.stem: A company wants to add an MFA solution for all employees who access the corporate network remotely. Log-in requirements include something you know, are, and have. The company wants a solution that does not require purchasing third-party applications or specialized hardware. Which of the following MFA solutions would best meet the company's requirements?
options: Smart card with PIN and password
Security questions and a one-time passcode sent via email
Voice and fingerprint verification with an SMS one-time passcode
A password, a one-time passcode generated on a mobile device, and facial recognition
questions.explanation: Password memenuhi faktor pengetahuan, ponsel dengan OTP memenuhi kepemilikan, dan pengenalan wajah memenuhi inherensi.

questions.stem: A company is using a legacy FTP server to transfer financial data to a third party. The legacy system does not support SFTP so a compensating control is needed to protect the sensitive, financial data in transit. Which of the following would be the most appropriate for the company to use?
questions.explanation: Tunneling SSH melindungi data pada jalur tunnel sementara layanan lama masih menggunakan FTP.

questions.stem: A security manager wants to reduce the number of steps required to identify and contain basic threats. Which of the following will help achieve this goal?
questions.explanation: SOAR mengorkestrasi playbook agar langkah deteksi dan containment yang berulang dapat diotomatisasi.

questions.stem: The Chief Information Officer (CIO) asked a vendor to provide documentation detailing the specific objectives within the compliance framework that the vendor's services meet. The vendor provided a report and a signed letter stating that the services meet 17 of the 21 objectives. Which of the following did the vendor provide to the CIO?
questions.explanation: Attestation of compliance adalah pernyataan formal yang menjelaskan persyaratan kepatuhan yang telah dipenuhi.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the most effective way to address OS vulnerabilities after they are identified?
questions.explanation: Patching memperbaiki kerentanan OS yang memiliki pembaruan. Kontrol pengganti diperlukan saat patch belum tersedia.

questions.stem: The management team reports that employees are missing features on company-provided tablets, which is causing productivity issues. The Management team directs the IT team to resolve the issue within 48 hours. Which of the following would be the best solution for the IT team to leverage in this scenario?
questions.explanation: MDM memungkinkan tim IT mendorong aplikasi dan konfigurasi ke tablet perusahaan secara terpusat.

questions.stem: A company is implementing a policy to allow employees to use their personal equipment for work. However, the company wants to ensure that only company-approved applications can be installed. Which of the following addresses this concern?
questions.explanation: MDM dapat menerapkan daftar aplikasi yang diizinkan pada perangkat atau profil kerja yang dikelola.

questions.stem: An alert references attacks associated with a zero-day exploit. An analyst places a bastion host in the network to reduce the risk of the exploit. Which of the following types of controls is the analyst implementing?
questions.explanation: Bastion menjadi kontrol kompensasi jika perbaikan langsung untuk kelemahan belum tersedia.

questions.stem: A penetration test has demonstrated that domain administrator accounts were vulnerable to pass-the-hash attacks. Which of the following would have been the best strategy to prevent the threat actor from using domain administrator accounts?
options: Audit each domain administrator account weekly for password compliance.
Implement a privileged access management solution.
Create IDS policies to monitor domain controller access.
Use Group Policy to enforce password expiration.
questions.explanation: PAM mengurangi paparan hak administrator lewat pengelolaan akun istimewa, akses sementara, dan kredensial terkelola.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of memory injection?
options: Two processes access the same variable, allowing one to cause a privilege escalation.
A process receives an unexpected amount of data, which causes malicious code to be executed.
Malicious code is copied to the allocated space of an already running process.
An executable is overwritten on the disk, and malicious code runs the next time it is executed.
questions.explanation: Injeksi memori mengubah ruang memori proses yang berjalan, berbeda dari mengganti executable pada disk.

questions.stem: A security administrator is implementing encryption on all hard drives in an organization. Which of the following security concepts is the administrator applying?
questions.explanation: Enkripsi drive melindungi kerahasiaan data tersimpan jika media diakses tanpa kunci.

questions.stem: A guest device is connected to a quarantine subnet. Which check best verifies that it meets the security requirements before access to corporate resources is granted?
questions.explanation: Pemeriksaan posture memastikan perangkat memenuhi persyaratan keamanan sebelum pindah dari karantina ke jaringan yang diizinkan.

questions.stem: A customer has a contract with a CSP (Cloud Service Provider) and wants to identify which controls should be implemented in the laaS enclave. Which of the following is most likely to contain this information?
questions.explanation: Matriks tanggung jawab menunjukkan kontrol yang dikelola penyedia cloud dan kontrol yang menjadi tanggung jawab pelanggan.

questions.stem: A Chief Information Security Officer is developing procedures to guide detective and corrective activities associated with common threats, including phishing, social engineering, and business email compromise. Which of the following documents would be most relevant to revise as part of this process?
questions.explanation: Incident response plan menetapkan tindakan untuk mendeteksi, menangani, dan memulihkan insiden.

questions.stem: A group of existing accounts needs the same set of permissions. Which approach best allows an administrator to update those permissions collectively?
questions.explanation: Security groups memungkinkan perubahan hak untuk banyak pengguna yang memerlukan kumpulan akses yang sama.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the fastest and most cost-effective way to confirm a third-party supplier's compliance with security obligations?
questions.explanation: Attestation merangkum pernyataan kepatuhan yang bisa ditinjau sebelum memutuskan apakah perlu penilaian independen.

questions.stem: Various company stakeholders meet to discuss roles and responsibilities in the event of a security breach that would affect offshore offices. Which of the following is this an example of?
questions.explanation: Tabletop exercise menguji koordinasi dan tanggung jawab melalui diskusi berbasis skenario.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a data protection strategy that uses tokenization?
options: Replacing sensitive data with surrogate values
Removing sensitive data from production systems
Hashing sensitive data in critical systems
questions.explanation: Tokenisasi mengganti nilai sensitif dengan nilai pengganti yang dapat dipakai tanpa membuka data aslinya.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of vulnerability that refers to the unauthorized installation of applications on a device through means other than the official application store?
questions.explanation: Sideloading adalah pemasangan aplikasi di luar toko resmi. Jailbreaking mengubah pembatasan platform.

questions.stem: Which of the following types of identification methods can be performed on a deployed application during runtime?
questions.explanation: Dynamic analysis mengamati perilaku dan keluaran program saat program sedang berjalan.

questions.stem: Which of the following cryptographic solutions is used to hide the fact that communication is occurring?
questions.explanation: Steganografi menyamarkan keberadaan pesan dengan menyisipkannya dalam media pembawa.

questions.stem: A security analyst notices an unusual amount of traffic hitting the edge of the network. Upon examining the logs, the analyst identifies a source IP address and blocks that address from communicating with the network. Even though the analyst is blocking this address, the attack is still ongoing and coming from a large number of different source IP addresses. Which of the following describes this type of attack?
questions.explanation: Banyak sumber yang mengirim trafik sekaligus membuat pemblokiran satu alamat tidak cukup untuk menghentikan DDoS.

questions.stem: A security engineer needs to quickly identify a signature from a known malicious file. Which of the following analysis methods would the security engineer most likely use?
questions.explanation: Analisis statis dapat mengambil hash atau pola file tanpa menjalankan file tersebut.

questions.stem: Which of the following should a company use to provide proof of external network security testing?
questions.explanation: Attestation pihak ketiga dapat menjadi bukti bahwa pengujian eksternal telah dilakukan sesuai cakupan yang dinyatakan.

questions.stem: A security administrator is addressing an issue with a legacy system that communicates data using an unencrypted protocol to transfer sensitive data to a third party. No software updates that use an encrypted protocol are available, so a compensating control is needed. Which of the following are the most appropriate for the administrator to suggest? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: SSH tunneling mengenkripsi jalur pengiriman. Segmentasi membatasi jaringan dan sistem yang dapat berinteraksi dengan layanan lama.

questions.stem: Which of the following steps in the risk management process involves establishing the scope and potential risks involved with a project?
questions.explanation: Risk identification memetakan risiko yang ada dalam lingkup proyek sebelum risiko dianalisis dan ditangani.

questions.stem: A company uses the domain company.example. A look-alike site uses c0mpany.example, with a zero instead of the letter o. Which type of attack does this illustrate?
questions.explanation: Typosquatting memanfaatkan nama domain yang mudah tertukar akibat salah ketik atau karakter yang mirip.

questions.stem: Which of the following allows a systems administrator to tune permissions for a file?
questions.explanation: ACL pada file menyatakan identitas yang dapat membaca, mengubah, atau menjalankan file tersebut.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the greatest concern for a company that is aware of the consequences of non-compliance with government regulations?
questions.explanation: Ketidakpatuhan dapat memicu sanksi seperti denda atau pembatasan operasional.

questions.stem: Which of the following security concepts is accomplished when granting access after an individual has logged into a computer network?
questions.explanation: Authentication menentukan identitas. Authorization menentukan resource dan tindakan yang diizinkan untuk identitas itu.

questions.stem: A growing organization, which hosts an externally accessible application, adds multiple virtual servers to improve application performance and decrease the resource usage on individual servers. Which of the following solutions is the organization most likely to employ to further increase performance and availability?
questions.explanation: Load balancer membagi permintaan ke server yang sehat untuk memperbaiki pemanfaatan kapasitas dan ketersediaan.

questions.stem: Users are entering their corporate email credentials on a fake site that mimics their company’s sign-in page. Which attack is taking place?
questions.explanation: Situs tiruan yang menangkap kredensial merupakan sarana phishing meski berasal dari kanal yang berbeda.

questions.stem: A security engineer needs to make sure employees can sign in to corporate systems only during their scheduled shifts. Which access control should the engineer use?
questions.explanation: Pembatasan berdasarkan waktu membatasi login ke jam kerja yang telah ditetapkan.

questions.stem: A company wants to ensure employees are allowed to copy files from a virtual desktop during the workday but are restricted during non-working hours. Which of the following security measures should the company set up?
questions.explanation: Aturan berbasis waktu dapat memberi akses penyalinan pada jam kerja dan menolaknya di luar jendela tersebut.

questions.stem: A systems administrator just purchased multiple network devices. Which of the following should the systems administrator perform to prevent attackers from accessing the devices by using publicly available information?
questions.explanation: Mengganti password bawaan menutup risiko masuk dengan kredensial publik yang dibagikan vendor.

questions.stem: Which of the following activities uses OSINT?
questions.explanation: OSINT menggunakan informasi yang tersedia publik. Dalam penilaian awareness yang sah, informasi tersebut dapat dipakai untuk menilai paparan publik.

questions.stem: Which of the following are the best security controls for controlling on-premises access? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Kartu akses mengontrol pintu dengan faktor kepemilikan, sedangkan pemindai biometrik mengikat akses pada pengguna.

questions.stem: A company is considering an expansion of access controls for an application thet contractors and internal employees use to reduce costs. Which of the following risk elements should the implementation team understand before granting access to the application?
questions.explanation: Risk appetite menyatakan tingkat risiko yang bersedia diterima organisasi saat mengejar manfaat bisnis.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the act of proving to a customer that software developers are trained on secure coding?
questions.explanation: Attestation merupakan pernyataan bahwa kondisi tertentu sudah terpenuhi, misalnya pelatihan secure coding.

questions.stem: An administrator is creating a secure method for a contractor to access a test environment. Which of the following would provide the contractor with the best access to the test environment?
questions.explanation: Jump server menjadi titik masuk terkendali dengan akses terbatas ke lingkungan pengujian.

questions.stem: A security analyst notices unusual behavior on the network. The IDS on the network was not able to detect the activities. Which of the following should the security analyst use to help the IDS detect such attacks in the future?
questions.explanation: Signature memberi IDS pola spesifik agar aktivitas serupa bisa dikenali pada kesempatan berikutnya.

questions.stem: To which of the following security categories does an EDR solution belong?
questions.explanation: EDR adalah kontrol teknis karena software pada endpoint mendeteksi dan membantu merespons aktivitas berbahaya.

questions.stem: A company relies on open-source software libraries to build the software used by its customers. Which of the following vulnerability types would be the most difficult to remediate due to the company’s reliance on open-source libraries?
questions.explanation: Zero-day menantang karena perbaikan dari maintainer mungkin belum tersedia.

questions.stem: An organization has a new regulatory requirement to implement corrective controls on a financial system. Which of the following is the most likely reason for the new requirement?
options: To defend against insider threats altering banking details
To ensure that errors are not passed to other systems
To allow for business insurance to be purchased
To prevent unauthorized changes to financial data
questions.explanation: Kontrol korektif membantu memperbaiki kondisi yang sudah salah sebelum kesalahan memengaruhi sistem lain.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the stage in an investigating when forensic images are obtained?
questions.explanation: Acquisition adalah tahap pengambilan salinan forensik. Preservation melindungi integritas bukti selama dan setelah pengambilan.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the difference between encryption and hashing?
options: Encryption protects data in transit, while hashing protects data at rest.
Encryption replaces cleartext with ciphertext, while hashing calculates a checksum.
Encryption ensures data integrity, while hashing ensures data confidentiality.
Encryption uses a public-key exchange, while hashing uses a private key.
questions.explanation: Enkripsi menghasilkan ciphertext yang bisa didekripsi dengan kunci. Hashing menghasilkan digest untuk perbandingan.

questions.stem: A security report shows that during a two-week test period, 20% of employees unwittingly disclosed their SSO credentials when accessing an external website. The organization purposely created the website to simulate a password complexity test. Which of the following would best help reduce the number of visits to similar websites in the future?
options: Block all outbound traffic from the intranet.
Introduce a campaign to recognize phishing attempts.
Restrict internet access for the employees who disclosed credentials.
Implement a deny list of websites.
questions.explanation: Pelatihan mengenali phishing membantu pengguna mengenali dan melaporkan situs tiruan saat domain penyerang berubah.

questions.stem: A Chief information Security Officer (CISO) has developed information security policies that relate to the software development methodology. Which of the following would the CISO most likely include in the organization's documentation?
questions.explanation: Persyaratan peer review dapat dimasukkan dalam kebijakan pengembangan untuk memeriksa perubahan sebelum digabung.

questions.stem:
An organization is developing a security program that conveys the responsibilities associated with the general operation of systems and software within the organization.
Which of the following documents would most likely communicate these expectations?
questions.explanation: AUP mendefinisikan tanggung jawab dan batasan pengguna saat menggunakan sistem organisasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best way to provide secure, remote access for employees while minimizing the exposure of a company’s internal network?
questions.explanation: VPN menyediakan akses melalui tunnel terenkripsi. RADIUS dan LDAP dapat mendukung autentikasi, sedangkan FTP untuk transfer file.

questions.stem: A company wants to track modifications to the code that is used to build new virtual servers. Which of the following will the company most likely deploy?
questions.explanation: Version control merekam perubahan kode, siapa yang mengubahnya, dan riwayat revisi.

questions.stem: Which of the following documents details how to accomplish a technical security task?
questions.explanation: Procedure menjelaskan langkah operasional untuk mengerjakan tugas keamanan secara konsisten.

questions.stem: While conducting a business continuity tabletop exercise, the security team becomes concerned by potential impact if a generator was to develop a fault during failover. Which of the following is the team most likely to consider in regard to risk management activities?
questions.explanation: Business impact analysis menilai dampak kegagalan dan membantu menetapkan prioritas serta target pemulihan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is prevented by proper data sanitization?
options: Hackers’ ability to obtain data from used hard drives
Devices reaching end-of-life and losing support
Disclosure of sensitive data through incorrect classification
Incorrect inventory data leading to a laptop shortage
questions.explanation: Sanitasi media mengurangi peluang data lama dibaca kembali setelah media dipindahkan, digunakan ulang, atau dibuang.

questions.stem: A certificate authority needs to publish a periodically updated list of certificates it revoked before their expiration dates. What should it publish?
questions.explanation: CRL menerbitkan daftar sertifikat yang dicabut oleh CA sebelum masa berlakunya berakhir.

questions.stem: Which of the following can best contribute to prioritizing patch applications?
questions.explanation: CVSS menyampaikan tingkat keparahan teknis. Prioritas patch juga perlu mempertimbangkan paparan, aset, dan eksploitasi aktif.

questions.stem: A systems administrator creates a script that validates OS version, patch levels, and installed applications when users log in. Which of the following examples best describes the purpose of this script?
questions.explanation: Pemeriksaan versi OS, patch, dan aplikasi memastikan endpoint sesuai dengan baseline yang ditetapkan.

questions.stem: Two readers in separate buildings record the same employee badge at nearly the same moment. Investigators confirm the employee was at only one location. Which activity best explains the log entries?
questions.explanation: Penggunaan identitas kartu yang sama secara tumpang tindih dapat mengindikasikan cloning. Konfirmasi dengan lokasi dan bukti tambahan.

questions.stem: Which of the following most accurately describes the order in which a security engineer should implement secure baselines?
questions.explanation: Tetapkan baseline terlebih dahulu, deploy konfigurasi tersebut, lalu rawat dan periksa penyimpangannya.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a reason environmental variables are a concern when reviewing potential system vulnerabilities?
options: The contents of environmental variables could affect the scope and impact of an exploited vulnerability.
In-memory environmental variable values can be overwritten and used by attackers to insert malicious code.
Environmental variables define cryptographic standards for the system and could create vulnerabilities if deprecated algorithms are used.
Environmental variables will determine when updates are run and could mitigate the likelihood of vulnerability exploitation.
questions.explanation: Variabel lingkungan dapat memuat konfigurasi internal atau token sehingga kebocoran proses dapat memperbesar dampak insiden.

questions.stem: A company evaluates several options that would allow employees to have remote access to the network. The security team wants to ensure the solution includes AAA to comply with internal security policies. Which of the following should the security team recommend?
options: Web proxy for all remote traffic
questions.explanation: IPsec melindungi transport VPN dan RADIUS menyediakan layanan authentication, authorization, serta accounting.

questions.stem: An administrator must replace an expired SSL certificate. Which of the following does the administrator need to create the new SSL certificate?
questions.explanation: CSR menyampaikan public key dan identitas kepada CA untuk pengajuan sertifikat yang baru.

questions.stem: A systems administrator receives a text message from an unknown number claiming to be the Chief Executive Officer of the company. The message states an emergency situation requires a password reset. Which of the following threat vectors is being used?
questions.explanation: Smishing adalah phishing lewat SMS. Penyamaran sebagai CEO merupakan taktik di dalam pesan itu.

questions.stem:
A Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) wants to:
+ Prevent employees from downloading malicious content.
+ Establish controls based on departments and users.
+ Map internet access for business applications to specific service accounts.
+ Restrict content based on categorization.
which of the following should the CSO implement?
questions.explanation: NGFW dapat menerapkan kebijakan berbasis identitas, aplikasi, malware, dan kategori konten jika fitur tersedia.

questions.stem: A company is aware of a given security risk related to a specific market segment. The business chooses not to accept responsibility and target their services to a different market segment. Which of the following describes this risk management strategy?
questions.explanation: Strategi avoid menghindari kegiatan yang menimbulkan risiko dengan memilih kegiatan atau pasar lain.

questions.stem: Following a password audit, which two requirements most directly reduce the use of easily guessed passwords? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Panjang minimum dan pemeriksaan terhadap daftar password umum atau bocor membantu mengurangi password yang mudah ditebak.

questions.stem: An organization wants to deploy software in a container environment to increase security. Which of the following would limit the organization's ability to achieve this goal?
questions.explanation: Monolit dapat menyulitkan pemisahan dan deployment komponen sebagai workload kontainer yang independen.

questions.stem: Prior to implementing a design change, the change must go through multiple steps to ensure that it does not cause any security issues. Which of the following is most likely to be one of those steps?
questions.explanation: Backout planning mempersiapkan cara membatalkan perubahan saat muncul gangguan atau risiko tak terduga.

questions.stem: Which of the following are the first steps an analyst should perform when developing a heat map? (Choose two.)
options: Methodically walk around the office noting Wi-Fi signal strength.
Log in to each access point and check the settings.
Create or obtain a layout of the office.
Measure cable lengths between access points.
Review access logs to determine the most active devices.
Remove possible impediments to radio transmissions.
questions.explanation: Denah menjadi dasar peta, lalu pengukuran sinyal di lokasi nyata menambahkan data cakupan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to improve security and overall functionality without losing critical application data?
questions.explanation: Patch memperbaiki software di tempat sehingga data aplikasi dapat tetap dipertahankan bila proses berjalan sesuai rencana.

questions.stem: An organization is preparing to export proprietary software to a customer. Which of the following would be the best way to prevent the loss of intellectual property?
questions.explanation: Obfuscation meningkatkan usaha untuk memahami kode yang didistribusikan. Perlindungannya terhadap reverse engineering terbatas.

questions.stem: Which of the following should be used to ensure a device is inaccessible to a network-connected resource?
questions.explanation: Host isolation membatasi komunikasi jaringan menuju dan dari perangkat tertentu.

questions.stem: In which of the following will unencrypted network traffic most likely be found?
questions.explanation: Perangkat IoT lama atau murah dapat memakai protokol tanpa enkripsi. Periksa protokol dan konfigurasi perangkatnya.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best reason to perform a tabletop exercise?
questions.explanation: Tabletop membantu menemukan celah dalam respons yang direncanakan sehingga IRP bisa diperbarui sebelum insiden nyata.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a use of CVSS?
options: To determine the cost associated with patching systems
To identify unused ports and services that should be closed
To analyze code for defects that could be exploited
To prioritize the remediation of vulnerabilities
questions.explanation: CVSS membantu triase lewat severity teknis. Prioritas akhir juga bergantung pada aset dan paparan.

questions.stem: For an upcoming product launch, a company hires a marketing agency whose owner is a close relative of the Chief Executive Officer. Which of the following did the company violate?
questions.explanation: Hubungan keluarga dalam keputusan pengadaan perlu diungkapkan dan dikelola sesuai kebijakan konflik kepentingan.

questions.stem: An organization designs an inbound firewall with a fail-open configuration while implementing a website. Which of the following would the organization consider to be the highest priority?
questions.explanation: Fail-open memprioritaskan kelangsungan layanan saat kontrol gagal, dengan trade-off terhadap pengendalian akses.

questions.stem: An engineer needs to ensure that a script has not been modified before it is launched. Which of the following best provides this functionality?
questions.explanation: Bandingkan hash script dengan digest tepercaya untuk memeriksa perubahan sebelum script dijalankan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most important element when defining effective security governance?
options: Developing procedures for employee onboarding and offboarding
Assigning roles and responsibilities for owners, controllers, and custodians
Defining and monitoring change management procedures
questions.explanation: Penetapan pemilik, pengendali, dan custodian memperjelas siapa yang bertanggung jawab atas keputusan keamanan.

questions.stem: A contractor is required to visually inspect the motherboards of all new servers that are purchased to determine whether the servers were tampered with. Which of the following risks is the contractor attempting to mitigate?
questions.explanation: Pemeriksaan perangkat sebelum dipakai mengurangi risiko perangkat diubah selama pembuatan, distribusi, atau pengiriman.

questions.stem: Which of the following could potentially be introduced at the time of side loading?
questions.explanation: Aplikasi dari sumber yang tidak tepercaya dapat membawa rootkit atau malware lain.

questions.stem: A company has yearly engagements with a service provider. The general terms and conditions are the same for all engagements. The company wants to simplify the process and revisit the general terms every three years. Which of the following documents would provide the best way to set the general terms?
questions.explanation: MSA menyimpan ketentuan umum lintas engagement sehingga ruang lingkup pekerjaan dapat berubah tanpa merundingkan ulang semua syarat.

questions.stem: While updating the security awareness training, a security analyst wants to address issues created if vendors’ email accounts are compromised. Which of the following recommendations should the security analyst include in the training?
options: Refrain from clicking on images included in emails from new vendors
Delete emails from unknown service provider partners.
Require that invoices be sent as attachments
Be alert to unexpected requests from familiar email addresses
questions.explanation: Permintaan yang menyimpang dari kebiasaan perlu diverifikasi melalui kanal lain walaupun berasal dari alamat vendor yang dikenal.

questions.stem: A new corporate policy requires all staff to use multifactor authentication to access company resources. Which of the following can be utilized to set up this form of identity and access management? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Token autentikasi adalah faktor kepemilikan, sedangkan biometrik adalah faktor inherensi.

questions.stem: A help desk employee receives a call from someone impersonating the Chief Executive Officer. The caller asks for assistance with resetting a password. Which of the following best describes this event?
questions.explanation: Vishing menggunakan panggilan suara untuk menyamar dan memengaruhi tindakan korban.

questions.stem: Which of the following actions best addresses a vulnerability found on a company's web server?
questions.explanation: Patching menghilangkan kerentanan software yang ditemukan ketika pembaruan vendor tersedia.

questions.stem: A company is concerned about employees unintentionally introducing malware into the network. The company identified fifty employees who clicked on a link embedded in an email sent by the internal IT department. Which of the following should the company implement to best improve its security posture?
questions.explanation: Simulasi phishing memberikan praktik mengenali pesan mencurigakan serta menilai perilaku setelah pelatihan.

questions.stem: A penetration test identifies that an SMBv1 is enabled on multiple servers across an organization. The organization wants to remediate this vulnerability in the most efficient way possible. Which of the following should the organization use for this purpose?
questions.explanation: Group Policy dapat menonaktifkan fitur SMBv1 pada banyak host Windows dengan satu kebijakan terpusat.

questions.stem: Which of the following best protects sensitive data in transit across a geographically dispersed infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Enkripsi dalam transit melindungi kerahasiaan data yang melintasi jaringan antarlokasi.

questions.stem: As part of new compliance audit requirements, multiple servers need to be segmented on different networks and should be reachable only from authorized internal systems. Which of the following would meet the requirements?
options: Configure firewall rules to block external access to Internal resources.
Set up a WAP to allow internal access from public networks.
Implement a new IPSec tunnel from internal resources.
Deploy an internal jump server to access resources.
questions.explanation: Jump server internal menyediakan jalur administratif terbatas ke segmen berbeda bersama aturan akses yang sesuai.

questions.stem: Which of the following activities should be performed first to compile a list of vulnerabilities in an environment?
questions.explanation: Pemindaian terotorisasi membantu menginventarisasi kelemahan lingkungan sebelum analisis dan prioritisasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be used to mitigate attacks from high-risk regions?
questions.explanation: IP geolocation dapat dipakai untuk menerapkan pembatasan berbasis wilayah. Lokasi IP tidak selalu menunjukkan lokasi sebenarnya.

questions.stem: A program manager wants to ensure contract employees can only access the company's computers Monday through Friday from 9 am. to 5 p.m. Which of the following would best enforce this access control?
options: Creating a GPO for all contract employees and setting time-of-day log-in restrictions
Creating a discretionary access policy and setting rule-based access for contract employees
Implementing an OAuth server and then setting least privilege for contract employees
Implementing SAML with federation to the contract employees’ authentication server
questions.explanation: Objek kebijakan untuk kelompok kontraktor dapat menerapkan jendela login sesuai hari dan jam kerja.

questions.stem: A recent power outage halted operations at a company’s only data center. Which of the following solutions would best prevent an event like this one in the future?
questions.explanation: Generator menyediakan listrik cadangan untuk gangguan yang lebih panjang, biasanya dengan UPS selama peralihan daya.

questions.stem: Which of the following analysis methods allows an organization to measure the exposure factor associated with organizational assets?
questions.explanation: Analisis kuantitatif menggunakan angka, misalnya exposure factor sebagai persentase penurunan nilai aset.

questions.stem: A security analyst notices an increase in port scans on the edge of the corporate network. Which of the following logs should the analyst check to obtain the attacker's source IP address?
questions.explanation: Log firewall di perimeter dapat mencatat sumber, tujuan, port, waktu, dan tindakan atas trafik percobaan.

questions.stem: A security team receives reports about high latency and complete network unavailability throughout most of the office building. Flow logs from the campus switches show high traffic on TCP 445. Which of the following is most likely the root cause of this incident?
questions.explanation: Trafik SMB yang meningkat cepat lintas perangkat dapat menandakan worm yang menyebar sendiri. Log host diperlukan untuk konfirmasi.

questions.stem: A security analyst is examining a penetration test report and notices that the tester pivoted to critical internal systems with the same local user ID and password. Which of the following would help prevent this in the future?
options: Implement centralized authentication with proper password policies
Add password complexity rules and increase password history limits
Connect the systems to an external authentication server
Limit the ability of user accounts to change passwords
questions.explanation: Autentikasi terpusat dan pengelolaan kredensial unik mengurangi penggunaan ulang password administrator lokal.

questions.stem: When used with an access control vestibule which of the following would provide the best prevention against tailgating?
questions.explanation: Petugas bisa memeriksa bahwa hanya satu orang berwenang yang melewati vestibule pada satu waktu.

questions.stem: A security professional discovers a folder that contains an employee's personal information located on the enterprise's shared drive. Which of the following best describes the data type the security professional should use to identify organizational policies and standards concerning the storage of employees’ personal information?
questions.explanation: Data pribadi karyawan termasuk data privasi dengan persyaratan penyimpanan dan akses khusus.

questions.stem: A site reliability engineer is designing a recovery strategy that requires quick failover to an identical site if the primary facility goes down. Which of the following types of sites should the engineer consider?
questions.explanation: Hot site memiliki infrastruktur dan kesiapan lebih tinggi untuk failover cepat dibanding warm atau cold site.

questions.stem: Which of the following would an organization most likely use to minimize the loss of data on a file server in the event data needs to be restored?
questions.explanation: Snapshot yang cukup sering menyediakan titik pemulihan file yang dekat dengan waktu gangguan.

questions.stem: Which of the following solutions would most likely be used in the financial industry to mask sensitive data?
questions.explanation: Tokenisasi mengganti nomor atau data finansial sensitif dengan nilai pengganti untuk pemrosesan yang terbatas.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of vulnerability that may result from outdated algorithms or keys?
questions.explanation: Algoritma usang atau kunci yang lemah mengurangi perlindungan kriptografi dan perlu ditinjau atau diganti.

questions.stem: A company wants to prevent proprietary and confidential company information from being shared to outsiders. Which of the following would this best describe?
questions.explanation: NDA mengatur perlindungan informasi rahasia dan membatasi pengungkapannya kepada pihak lain.

questions.stem: A security administrator needs to reduce the attack surface in the company's data centers. Which of the following should the security administrator do to complete this task?
options: Define Group Policy on the servers.
Configure the servers for high availability.
questions.explanation: Memperbarui atau mengganti OS yang tidak lagi didukung mengurangi paparan yang tidak dapat diperbaiki lewat patch rutin.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a prerequisite for a DLP solution?
questions.explanation: Klasifikasi data menentukan informasi apa yang perlu dipantau dan dilindungi oleh aturan DLP.

questions.stem: A business provides long-term cold storage services to banks that are required to follow regulator-imposed data retention guidelines. Banks that use these services require that data is disposed of in a specific manner at the conclusion of the regulatory threshold for data retention. Which of the following aspects of data management is the most important to the bank in the destruction of this data?
questions.explanation: Sertifikasi memberikan bukti bahwa data dimusnahkan sesuai proses yang ditetapkan.

questions.stem: The physical security team at a company receives reports that employees are not displaying their badges. The team also observes employees tailgating at controlled entrances. Which of the following topics will the security team most likely emphasize in upcoming security training?
questions.explanation: Situational awareness melatih pengguna mengenali perilaku seperti tailgating dan pelanggaran penggunaan badge.

questions.stem: Which of the following would most likely be a hacktivist's motive?
questions.explanation: Hacktivist biasanya bertindak untuk mendukung keyakinan sosial, politik, atau ideologi.

questions.stem: During a recent log review, an analyst discovers evidence of successful injection attacks. Which of the following will best address this issue?
questions.explanation: Validasi input membatasi format yang diterima. Untuk SQL injection, gunakan juga query berparameter saat mengakses database.

questions.stem: A security analyst receives an alert that there was an attempt to download known malware. Which of the following actions would allow the best chance to analyze the malware?
options: Review the IPS logs and determine which command-and-control IPs were blocked.
Analyze application logs to see how the malware attempted to maintain persistence.
Run vulnerability scans to check for systems and applications that are vulnerable to the malware
Obtain and execute the malware in a sandbox environment and perform packet captures.
questions.explanation: Analisis dinamis dalam sandbox terisolasi dapat mengamati perilaku dan komunikasi sampel tanpa mengekspos jaringan produksi.

questions.stem: Which of the following should be used to ensure a user has the permissions needed to effectively do an assigned job role?
questions.explanation: Least privilege membatasi hak pengguna pada kebutuhan pekerjaannya, termasuk akses yang hanya berlaku sementara bila sesuai.

questions.stem: An Unexpected out-of-character email from a Chief Executive Officer's corporate account asked an employee to provide financial information and to change the recipient's contact number. Which of the following attack vectors is most likely being used?
questions.explanation: Permintaan finansial yang menyimpang dari akun bisnis tepercaya adalah indikator business email compromise. Verifikasi melalui kanal lain.

questions.stem: Which of the following should an organization use to ensure that it can review the controls and performance of a service provider or vendor?
questions.explanation: Right-to-audit clause menetapkan hak organisasi untuk menilai kontrol dan kinerja penyedia layanan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to calculate the impact to an organization per cybersecurity incident?
questions.explanation: Single Loss Expectancy memperkirakan kerugian dalam satu insiden. Annualized Loss Expectancy memperkirakan total kerugian per tahun.

questions.stem: A retail company receives a request to remove a customer's data. Which of the following is the retail company considered under GDPR legislation?
questions.explanation: Data controller menentukan tujuan dan cara pemrosesan data pribadi pelanggan.

questions.stem: An administrator implements web-filtering products but still sees that users are visiting malicious links. Which of the following configuration items does the security administrator need to review?
questions.explanation: Content categorization mengelompokkan situs untuk membantu menentukan kategori yang diblokir atau diizinkan.

questions.stem: Which of the following phases of the incident response process attempts to minimize disruption?
questions.explanation: Containment membatasi dampak dan penyebaran insiden. Recovery memulihkan sistem setelah lingkungan terkendali.

questions.stem: A security operations team is triaging five independent incidents. For each scenario, identify the most likely attack and choose the best immediate or preventative action.

tasks.label: Web server · Many systems simultaneously exhaust the server’s capacity to establish new connections. · Attack
Scenario 1 · Response
choices: Isolate the endpoint and investigate the unauthorized remote session
Rotate exposed database credentials and contain affected hosts
Remove the device and reset exposed credentials from a trusted endpoint
Remove the hidden access path and review the code

tasks.label: Workstation · An unauthorized tool on a user’s device opens a channel for remote command execution. · Attack
Scenario 2 · Response
choices: Isolate the endpoint and investigate the unauthorized remote session
Rotate exposed database credentials and contain affected hosts
Remove the device and reset exposed credentials from a trusted endpoint
Remove the hidden access path and review the code

tasks.label: Database network · Malware replicates itself across hosts that still share a default credential. · Attack
Scenario 3 · Response
choices: Isolate the endpoint and investigate the unauthorized remote session
Rotate exposed database credentials and contain affected hosts
Remove the device and reset exposed credentials from a trusted endpoint
Remove the hidden access path and review the code

tasks.label: Executive workstation · A physical device attached to the keyboard cable records keystrokes. · Attack
Scenario 4 · Response
choices: Isolate the endpoint and investigate the unauthorized remote session
Rotate exposed database credentials and contain affected hosts
Remove the device and reset exposed credentials from a trusted endpoint
Remove the hidden access path and review the code

tasks.label: Internal application · A review finds a hidden path that skips ordinary authentication. · Attack
Scenario 5 · Response
choices: Isolate the endpoint and investigate the unauthorized remote session
Rotate exposed database credentials and contain affected hosts
Remove the device and reset exposed credentials from a trusted endpoint
Remove the hidden access path and review the code

questions.explanation: DDoS mitigation menangani banjir trafik dari banyak sumber. Isolasi endpoint menghentikan kanal RAT. Worm perlu dibatasi penyebarannya dan kredensial yang terpapar dirotasi. Untuk keylogger fisik, singkirkan perangkat dan reset kredensial dari endpoint tepercaya. Backdoor perlu dihapus dan kode terkait diaudit.

questions.stem: An administrator is setting up SSH key authentication for an authorized maintenance account for the first time. Put the three required steps in order. Each step can be used once.

tasks.label: Step 1
choices: Generate a key pair on the client
Register the public key with the remote user account
Verify login using the client key
Copy the private key to the server
Make the private key readable by everyone

tasks.label: Step 2
choices: Generate a key pair on the client
Register the public key with the remote user account
Verify login using the client key
Copy the private key to the server
Make the private key readable by everyone

tasks.label: Step 3
choices: Generate a key pair on the client
Register the public key with the remote user account
Verify login using the client key
Copy the private key to the server
Make the private key readable by everyone

questions.explanation: Buat pasangan kunci pada klien, daftarkan public key ke akun yang dituju melalui kanal yang sudah terotorisasi, lalu verifikasi login. Private key tetap berada pada klien dengan izin terbatas.

questions.stem: Two public web servers must stay available and be separated from internal systems. Assign a control to each location based on its stated requirement.

tasks.label: Provider edge · Absorb volumetric traffic before it saturates the site’s uplink.
Web tier · Distribute client requests across two healthy web servers.
Boundary between tiers · Allow only approved traffic between the web network and internal network.
Power input · Keep servers running briefly during a utility power interruption.

questions.explanation: Upstream DDoS protection mengurangi banjir sebelum mencapai uplink. Load balancer membagi trafik dan mengecualikan server yang tidak sehat. Internal firewall menegakkan segmentasi. UPS menjembatani gangguan daya singkat.

questions.stem: Use the topology in the reference and the following synthetic evidence. Assume monitoring covers all five hosts and only listed executions are malicious. Classify each host, then isolate the affected segments while preserving the Internet interface.

tasks.label: 192.168.10.22 · 09:01 first execution of the malicious process, then connects to .37 and 10.10.9.12.
192.168.10.37 · 09:03 executes the same process after receiving traffic from .22.
192.168.10.41 · No malicious execution and no observed propagation traffic.
10.10.9.12 · 09:04 executes the same process after receiving traffic from .22.
10.10.9.18 · No malicious execution and no observed propagation traffic.
Containment · Block forwarding between the two affected segments during investigation.
choices: Block forwarding between Int A and Int B
Allow unrestricted traffic between Int A and Int B

questions.explanation: Eksekusi paling awal pada .22 disusul eksekusi pada .37 dan 10.10.9.12. Dua host tanpa indikator diberi status clean sesuai asumsi skenario. Membatasi forwarding antara Int A dan Int B menghambat penyebaran antarsemen, sementara investigasi dan isolasi host dilakukan.
